name: smwgraphics-mega-man-x3-safari-park
title: Mega Man X3 - Safari Park
description:
Here's a rip of Neon Tiger's level from Megaman X3. It's a pretty large portion of the level but there's a few tiles that had to get left out sadly.

Comes with 3 ExGFX files and just about everything else you need.

Credit would be nice but it's not required.
